theme: Patching a matcher that gets a few strings wrong
title: One Edit to Rule Them All: Repairing a Broken Matcher
strategies: trivial: submit zero edits -- reproduces the checker's own baseline (the damaged automaton's raw held-out accuracy)

greedy: for each visible failing example, run it and toggle the accept-flag of wherever that specific run ends up -- fixes the example shown but is a per-example special case that rarely transfers to held-out strings, and can introduce new mistakes

strong: brute-force search the automaton's small single-edit space (toggle one accept bit / add one epsilon edge / retarget one transition) for the ONE edit that makes ALL visible examples correct at once -- this recovers the shared structural defect instead of memorizing symptoms

(headroom above strong): a solver that also reasons about which of several equally-consistent single edits best matches the STRUCTURE of the given automaton (e.g. preferring edits at motif-boundary epsilon edges or star loop edges over incidental coincidences), or that falls back to a minimal 2-edit search when the single-edit space is genuinely ambiguous
